title: Commercial Courts
lead: Before 2015, commercial disputes went to regular civil courts with all their backlogs. The ==Commercial Courts, Commercial Division and Commercial Appellate Division of High Courts Act, 2015== built specialised judicial infrastructure — ==institutionalising speed, specialisation and structure==.

items.title: Objectives
bullets: ==Speedy disposal== of high-value commercial disputes
Improve ==ease of doing business== by strengthening ==contract enforcement==
Create ==specialised judicial infrastructure== for commercial matters

items.title: Institutional Tiers
bullets: ==District level — Commercial Courts==: for areas where High Courts have ==ordinary original civil jurisdiction (OOCJ)== — Delhi, Bombay, Madras, Calcutta
==High Court level — Commercial Division==: bench for cases above the specified value
==Commercial Appellate Division==: hears appeals from both Commercial Courts and Commercial Divisions

items: ==Commercial disputes (s.2(1)(c))==: ordinary transactions of merchants, bankers, financiers and traders; partnership agreements; ==intellectual property (trademarks, patents, copyrights)==; insurance, construction contracts, joint ventures; sale of goods; immovable property ==used exclusively in trade or commerce==.
==Specified value==: initially ==₹1 crore (s.2(1)(i))==; reduced by the ==2018 Amendment to ₹3 lakh== to widen access.
The ==2018 Amendment== also empowered State Governments to constitute Commercial Courts ==at district judge level== in OOCJ areas.

items.title: Timelines
bullets: ==Written statement within 120 days== of service — else ==forfeiture of the right to defend== (s.16)
==Case Management Hearings (s.15A)== — judges schedule filings, framing of issues, evidence
==Judgment within 90 days== of conclusion of arguments
==Appeals: filed within 60 days, disposed within 6 months==

items.title: Features
bullets: ==Specialised judges== with commercial-dispute experience
==Mandatory e-filing== of documents and affidavits; digital case management
==Costs regime== — actual costs awarded to discourage frivolous litigation
==Summary judgments (s.16)== where no real triable issue exists

items.title: Issues
bullets: ==Infrastructure gaps==
==Capacity constraints==
==Compliance with timelines==
==Limited awareness==
==Appeal backlog==

items.title: Way Forward
bullets: ==Capacity building== — specialised training for judges and staff
==Expansion== — commercial courts in every district
==Digital integration== — e-filing, virtual hearings, case tracking
==ADR strengthening== — institutionalise pre-litigation mediation through private centres
==Periodic review== — regular audits of disposal efficiency

blocks.text: By institutionalizing speed, specialization and structure, the Commercial Courts Act bridges the gap between legal certainty and economic growth.
